mapper.select: select (select count(*) from biz_device where del_flag = '0') as deviceTotal, (select count(*) from biz_device where del_flag = '0' and status = 'running') as runningCount, (select count(*) from biz_device where del_flag = '0' and status = 'repairing') as repairingCount, (select count(*) from biz_device where del_flag = '0' and status = 'stopped') as stoppedCount, (select count(*) from biz_repair_order where del_flag = '0') as orderTotal, (select count(*) from biz_repair_order where del_flag = '0' and status = '0') as pendingCount, (select count(*) from biz_repair_order where del_flag = '0' and status = '1') as processingCount, (select count(*) from biz_repair_order where del_flag = '0' and status = '2') as finishedCount, (select ifnull(round(sum(cost)), 0) from biz_repair_record where del_flag = '0' and record_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 30 day)) as monthCost, (select ifnull(round(sum(cost)), 0) from biz_repair_record where del_flag = '0') as totalCost, (select ifnull(round(100 * sum(result = 'normal') / count(*), 1), 0) from biz_inspect where del_flag = '0') as inspectPassRate, (select count(*) from biz_part where del_flag = '0' and stock <= safety_stock) as partWarning, (select count(*) from biz_inspect where del_flag = '0' and date(inspect_time) = curdate()) as inspectToday

select ifnull(d.dict_label, v.status) as name, count(*) as value from biz_device v left join sys_dict_data d on d.dict_type = 'device_status' and d.dict_value = v.status where v.del_flag = '0' group by ifnull(d.dict_label, v.status) order by value desc

select ifnull(d.dict_label, v.device_type) as name, count(*) as value from biz_device v left join sys_dict_data d on d.dict_type = 'device_type' and d.dict_value = v.device_type where v.del_flag = '0' group by ifnull(d.dict_label, v.device_type) order by value desc

with recursive seq as ( select date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) as dt union all select date_add(dt, interval 1 day) from seq where dt < curdate() ) select date_format(s.dt, '%m-%d') as name, (select count(*) from biz_repair_order o where o.del_flag = '0' and date(o.report_time) = s.dt) as value from seq s order by s.dt

select ifnull(d.dict_label, o.fault_type) as name, count(*) as value from biz_repair_order o left join sys_dict_data d on d.dict_type = 'fault_type' and d.dict_value = o.fault_type where o.del_flag = '0' group by ifnull(d.dict_label, o.fault_type) order by value desc

select v.device_name as name, round(sum(r.cost)) as value from biz_repair_record r join biz_device v on v.device_id = r.device_id where r.del_flag = '0' group by v.device_id, v.device_name order by value desc limit #{limit}

with recursive seq as ( select date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) as dt union all select date_add(dt, interval 1 day) from seq where dt < curdate() ) select date_format(s.dt, '%m-%d') as name, sum(case when i.result = 'normal' then 1 else 0 end) as normal, sum(case when i.result = 'abnormal' then 1 else 0 end) as abnormal from seq s left join biz_inspect i on date(i.inspect_time) = s.dt and i.del_flag = '0' group by s.dt order by s.dt
